author: Jay
name: ContainerStatus
short: Live Discord status cards for any Docker container, read from Arcane.
description: Posts a card for a Docker container in a channel and keeps editing it: a 🟢 / 🟠 / 🔴 dot for up, starting or restarting, and down (🔵 when it's up and Arcane's update check found a newer image), how long it has been up, an optional description and an optional link to open the service. It can also put the dot at the start of a channel's name. Cards can come from any Arcane environment. The bot only reads container status from Arcane's API; it can't start, stop or change anything. Cards are only updated while the bot is running.
install_msg: In Arcane, make a key whose role only has containers:list and containers:read (add environments:list to use more than one environment). DM the bot: [p]set api arcane url <arcane url> api_key <key>. Check it with [p]containercard show, then post a card with [p]containercard add #channel <container> [title]. [p]containercard containers lists the container names in every environment; use name@environment for one outside the default. For a 🟢 / 🟠 / 🔴 at the start of a channel's name, give the bot Manage Channels on it and run [p]containercard dots add #channel [card]; don't also put pzadmin cog dots on the same channel.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no data about users.
